evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Aphoristic equivalence frames an unrehearsed rollback as no rollback at all — logic deployed to make the factual case for the cadence, controlling the facts that define the situation.
Structural declaration of an operational parameter from the position-holder's authority — legitimate power codifying the directive into a formal spec line.
Self-assignment of ownership in a formal spec line — legitimate power exercised by claiming the accountable role from the position that confers it.
